_about: Then-versus-now checks. Each scenario takes an earlier conversation (a key from history.json, or one written here), the products the user named, and FIXED search results, so verdicts don't depend on what the web says today. The model extracts claims from the old answer and reads current values from these results; code checks every quote and decides each verdict. expect lists the verdict for each product (and the attribute word to look for).
